proposal.expected_benefit: Reduces contradictions between audit requirements and simulation contexts, ensuring that the defense's actions are both contextually appropriate and aligned with the scenario's nature.
proposal.problem: The defense's mitigation 'audit-before-execution' is unnecessary in a simulation-only context, leading to a contradiction with the attack summary stating 'No adversarial payload is present' and 'simulation_only' is true.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the strategy to ensure that audit requirements are context-aware, distinguishing between simulation-only scenarios and real-world execution contexts. This will prevent unnecessary audit mandates in simulations and align the defense's actions with the actual scenario context.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit Context in Simulation-Only Scenarios
verification_tests: Check if audit requirements are dynamically adjusted based on simulation status
Verify that the defense's mitigation aligns with the scenario's simulation_only flag
